name: RELAY
description: A high-energy identity for real-time infrastructure. A stepped signal, acid yellow, and compact technical typography communicate speed without visual clutter.
heading: unbounded
rules: Use the three-step signal at fixed proportions.
Acid yellow carries action; terminal carries technical detail.
Number modules and keep specification labels in monospaced capitals.

system.concept: Oscilloscope ribbons, precise terminal frames, numbered modules, and sharply electric signal color. A technical world with unmistakable speed and editorial discipline.
headline: Keep your ideas
moving forward.
features: A clear foundation for information that keeps moving.
Technical detail organized around the job you need to do.
Purposeful tools, legible interfaces, and fewer unnecessary steps.
system.layoutNote: Terminal-black hero with acid-yellow type and waveform art. Numbered modules, monospaced labels, 3px corners, and rectangular controls. No candy gradients or floating cards.
